evidence: Touches transaction building and fee bumping logic across src/wallet/spend.cpp, src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, and src/wallet/coincontrol.h with the Wallet label.
rationale: Prevents replacement transactions from decreasing nLockTime below the original transaction's locktime, eliminating an on-chain fingerprint identifying Bitcoin Core wallet users. The wallet category prioritizes privacy of transaction creation against fingerprinting, though this specific backdating anomaly affects less than 2% of replacements and is reasonably deferrable.
